author: Neuralink
description:
What is neuron degeneration? 

Skyler, a machine learning engineer at Neuralink, shares how brain-computer interfaces could bypass neural pathways that are broken due to ALS, helping restore the ability to speak to those who have lost it.

Watch the full story here: https://youtu.be/u8mmn9lOIyw

Note: Neuralink devices are investigational and are not commercially available or FDA approved. There are no guaranteed benefits from participating in a Neuralink clinical trial.
title: Building Brain Interfaces For ALS
